metrics.label: Team rating
metrics.desc: Points per game better than an average team on a neutral field (our team strength; our EPA rating when it is not available).

metrics.label: Offence rating
metrics.desc: Offensive points per game over average.

metrics.label: Defence rating
metrics.desc: Defensive points per game over average (positive = better).

metrics.label: Offence EPA / play
metrics.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play (offence).

metrics.label: Defence EPA / play
metrics.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play allowed.

metrics.label: Pass offence EPA
metrics.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per dropback.

metrics.label: Rush offence EPA
metrics.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per designed run.

metrics.label: Pass defence EPA
metrics.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per dropback allowed.

metrics.label: Rush defence EPA
metrics.desc: Opponent-adjusted EPA per designed run allowed.

metrics.label: Special teams EPA / game
metrics.desc: EPA per game on kicks, punts and returns (net of the opponent's).

metrics.label: Offence success
metrics.desc: Share of plays with positive EPA.

metrics.label: Defence success allowed
metrics.desc: Share of opponent plays with positive EPA.

metrics.label: PROE
metrics.desc: Pass rate over expected (nflfastR xpass), all plays.

metrics.label: PROE (neutral)
metrics.desc: Pass rate over expected on early downs, win probability 20-80 %, outside the last two minutes of a half.

metrics.label: PROE (3rd down)
metrics.desc: Pass rate over expected on third down.

metrics.label: PROE (red zone)
metrics.desc: Pass rate over expected inside the opponent's 20.

metrics.label: PROE (leading 8+)
metrics.desc: Pass rate over expected when leading by 8 or more.

metrics.label: PROE (trailing 8+)
metrics.desc: Pass rate over expected when trailing by 8 or more.

metrics.label: Shotgun rate
metrics.desc: Share of scrimmage plays from shotgun.

metrics.label: No-huddle rate
metrics.desc: Share of plays without a huddle.

metrics.label: Play-action rate
metrics.desc: Play action per dropback (FTN, 2022 onward).

metrics.label: RPO rate
metrics.desc: Run-pass options per scrimmage play (FTN, 2022 onward).

metrics.label: Motion rate
metrics.desc: Pre-snap motion per scrimmage play (FTN, 2022 onward).

metrics.label: Screen rate
metrics.desc: Screens per pass attempt (FTN, 2022 onward).

metrics.label: Blitz rate
metrics.desc: Dropbacks against five or more rushers or any blitzer (FTN, 2022 onward).

metrics.label: Box count
metrics.desc: Average defenders in the box (FTN 2022 onward; participation before).

metrics.label: Man coverage rate
metrics.desc: Man coverage per dropback (participation, 2016-2025).

metrics.label: Pressure rate allowed
metrics.desc: Share of dropbacks under pressure (our pressure model: participation 2016-2025, modelled otherwise).

metrics.label: Pressure rate (defence)
metrics.desc: Share of opponent dropbacks pressured.

metrics.label: Seconds / play (neutral)
metrics.desc: Seconds between consecutive offensive snaps in neutral situations (lower = faster).

metrics.label: Seconds / play
metrics.desc: Seconds between consecutive offensive snaps.

metrics.label: Plays / game
metrics.desc: Offensive scrimmage plays per game.

metrics.label: 4th-down go rate
metrics.desc: Share of fourth downs (not end-of-half kneel / desperation) where the offence went for it.

metrics.label: Go when advised
metrics.desc: Share of fourth downs our model says to go for where the team went.

metrics.label: WP lost on 4th downs
metrics.desc: Win probability given up against the model's recommendation, summed over the season's fourth downs.

ratings_units: points per game against an average team (pass / rush units: EPA per play edges)
